email_subject: Application - Marketing Professional, BMC Center of Excellence
email_body:
Dear EY Recruitment Team,

I'd like to apply for the Marketing Professional role in the BMC Center of Excellence.

My work sits where marketing, design and code overlap. I design and build WordPress sites - including a hand-coded WebGL hero and accessible markup on my own site - and I write the SEO and content strategy behind them. At Episto I maintain client builds such as a pharmacists' association site with a reusable layout for around 600 member profile pages, and at Knowledge Experts I helped build digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo.

I'll be upfront: Ceros, Flourish and Figma are new to me. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WordPress and design consistency are not, and I pick up tools quickly - I have an app on Google Play and build my own automations.

My CV is attached. I'd be glad to talk.

cover_letter:
Dear EY Recruitment Team,

I'm applying for the Marketing Professional role in the BMC Center of Excellence. My background sits where digital marketing, design and code meet: SEO and content strategy on one side, and the HTML, CSS and JavaScript to build what I design on the other.

On baverok.com I designed and built a WordPress/Elementor landing page with a hand-coded WebGL hero, structured data and accessible markup - the visual-first, interactive kind of work this role describes. For a Belgian youth chess champion at mirook.com I built and optimized a multi-page site, added JSON-LD schema and knowledge-graph markup, and ran iterative technical audits that measurably raised its search-health score. At Knowledge Experts I supported the team building SharePoint-based digital workplaces for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo. At Episto I publish and maintain client sites, including a pharmacists' association site where I keep a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profile pages - reusable structure, maintained over time, which is close to the template-and-guidance work a CoE does.

I'll be straightforward: I haven't worked in Ceros, Flourish or Figma yet. What I bring instead is a working knowledge of front-end code, daily use of AI tools for research and production, and a record of learning new systems fast - I taught myself enough to ship an Android app and to build MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tools. UX matters to me because I run live sites and see what confuses people: I favour clear hierarchy, accessible markup and layouts that hold up on a phone.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I'd grow into the Ceros and Flourish side of the Center of Excellence while contributing immediately to content, CMS work and the quality of the experiences you ship.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
